reviewItem.question: For "Pilot: Traefik Pilot is no longer available since October 4th, 2022", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether the static configuration file (YAML/TOML) contains a pilot section

proposed.statement: Traefik Pilot static configuration (e.g. pilot.token) is no longer supported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting; it must be removed from the static configuration.
